name: Anu LMS Example: Custom paragraph
description: Example module showing how to extend Anu LMS with a custom paragraph by swapping in project-built React bundles.
project_description: Example submodule of Anu LMS (package 'Anu LMS Examples'). Demonstrates extending the Anu LMS React front end with a custom paragraph type by implementing hook_library_info_alter to repoint the anu_lms JS libraries (js/dist/*) at this module's own compiled bundles, so a project can ship a rebuilt front end that includes a new paragraph component. A copy-and-adapt developer template, not for production.
